arg.name: gz_topics
arg.description: The sonars' gz-transport topics, as a list

arg.name: ros_topics
arg.description: The ROS 2 topics, one per gz topic

arg.name: frame_ids
arg.description: Frames to stamp, as a list; an empty entry for the default

arg.name: kinds
arg.description: Per sonar, image (the default) or detections for a profiler

arg.name: view
arg.description: Also publish a /view image beside each ROS topic

arg.name: lazy
arg.description: Subscribe to a sonar in Gazebo only while one of its ROS topics has a subscriber, so an unwatched sonar does not ping

arg.name: reliability
arg.description: QoS reliability of every publisher: reliable, or best_effort for a lossy link (which RViz's default displays do not receive)
